# Auto-generated by mods/glorpui_hints/tools/generate.py from the EU5 game files. Do not edit by hand.
# Whether a reform, policy or privilege can be taken now. Glorp UI's
# bodies under this mod's names; PREV inside each block is the country.

svx_reform_core = {
	government_reform:$KEY$ = {
		is_implementable_in = PREV
		NOT = { is_fully_implemented_in = PREV }
	}
}

# is_fully_implemented_in on a policy is true whenever its law is in force,
# so the current policy is ruled out with has_policy instead.
svx_policy_core = {
	policy:$KEY$ = {
		is_implementable_in = PREV
	}
	NOT = { has_policy = $KEY$ }
	law:$LAW$ = {
		OR = {
			is_fully_implemented_in = PREV
			is_implementable_in = PREV
		}
	}
}

svx_privilege_takeable = {
	estate_privilege:$KEY$ = {
		is_implementable_in = PREV
		NOT = { is_fully_implemented_in = PREV }
	}
}
